topography.project_purpose: Cross Chain Bridge. Structurally: 75 project-authored contract(s) across 12 chain(s); 8 ERC20 tokens; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 9 functional families. Its contracts share 36 common project-authored base contract(s) (bridgepool, multicaller, lockable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
